profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Draftkings
profile.summary: Much of my experience is in Full-Stack Web Dev and Android Development. I'm also interested in exploring User Experience Design, Game Development, and Data Science.

positions.title: Android Development Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a food ordering app with the Android Platform using Kotlin
- Followed the Model View ViewModel design pattern to bind UI, logic, and data
- Added features for user profiles and database integration with Firebase

positions.title: Data Science/Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Used Python/Pandas to manipulate Covid-related data of over 11 million Twitter users
- Constructed a method to assign a score to users based on their credibility on Covid information
- Developed a complete study to be deployed on Amazon’s Mechanical Turk that evaluates
the accuracy of the credibility scores

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
- Assisted clients in troubleshooting technical issues with their PC and mobile devices
- Supervised consultants and account specialists to manage influx of clients
- Collaborated with IT support team and online resources to find solutions

positions.title: Web Developer/Project Management Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and developed the frontend of a life coaching web app using React
- Integrated the features for booking workshops, a commerce page, and a gallery
- Followed Agile Software Development principles and the MERN stack to build the app over
the course of a semester

company.name: Deeproots Arts & Culture Creative Services LLC

positions.title: Game Development
positions.description:
- Worked as the lead developer on a 2D game in the 48-hour marathon
- Developed a prototype game implemented with Unity
- Utilized scripting with C# to animate and add logic to the game

positions.title: Project Intern
positions.description:
- Coordinated the flow of information internally as a team member
- Created promotional robot prototype and educational program for children
- Designed project graphics in Photoshop
